csv_project_name: Design for Dragon's Lair-Hunt Student Union Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The State University of New York at Oneonta is seeking qualifications from design firms/teams for the design to renovate a gaming lounge inside the Student Union. The contract will be for design development through construction administration. The Dragon s Lair is a ~1,400 SF lounge space located on the first floor of Hunt Student Union at SUNY Oneonta. The space currently serves as a gaming lounge for students. The intent is to fully renovate the Dragon s Lair to improve the functionality of the space, and include eSports club programming into the lounge. Develop design documents, from schematic design through construction documents, for the gut renovation of the Dragon s Lair. The selected firm shall use the concept study as a basis for developing the documents. Services shall also include bid and construction administration services, and a third party pre-bid estimate.
